summary.text: First page of the WHO measles and rubella elimination country profile for Slovakia, giving 2017 demographic data, surveillance arrangements, the immunization schedule, coverage and a monthly measles case chart for 2013-2017.

blocks.content: Map of Slovakia and its regions showing measles cases by first subnational level, 2017, with red dots (one dot per case, placed randomly within regions). The dots are clustered in the far west near the border with Austria and in the far east near the border with Ukraine; neighbouring countries are labelled.

Map of Slovakia and its regions showing measles genotypes by first subnational level, 2017: two blue dots appear in the westernmost region near the border with Austria. The genotype legend is not part of the image.
